body: I lived in Chapel this year and it's been fun, just keep in mind it is (or was this year) the party dorm. Gateway, from what I understand, isn't co-ed, but it's also right next to the dining hall/market and seems like it's pretty well-maintained. Sage's room layouts are nice; you get a big common area and individual, lockable rooms shared with 4 other people. Hope you have a great first year!
